Aggregates code violation counts by tract for 2024 and 2025, computes the year-over-year increase, left joins all tracts, and ranks the largest increases descending with tract name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2024,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_68f9be' AND source = 'm1_city' AND geoid IS NOT NULL AND value_kind = 'count'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(y.code_violations_2024, 0) AS code_violations_2024,
       COALESCE(y.code_violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025,
       (COALESCE(y.code_violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(y.code_violations_2024, 0)) AS increase_in_code_violations,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN yearly y ON t.geoid = y.geoid
ORDER BY increase_in_code_violations DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
